I merged one of the four labelled bumps (#1991). I wrote `merge-bumps.sh`, but I haven't run it yet because the command was held for approval.

- **#1991 Bump chalk-5.4.2:** merged (squash).

The script takes `OWNER REPO LABEL` and uses only curl and jq. For each open labelled PR it reads the `allowed-now` link and merges only when `pulls/merge` is allowed. Otherwise it prints the `notAllowed` reason for `pulls/merge`. You can point it at a different API with the `API_BASE` environment variable.

To test it, run `chmod +x merge-bumps.sh && ./merge-bumps.sh JogoShugh heart-github-test mess-A-gen-proxy-1`. #1991 is already merged, so it should no longer be listed and the other three should come back not merged with the same reasons.
